name: Immoral Empire
source:
Holy City Eruku, an eden of holy maidens.
On the much-awaited day of Queen Sophia's coronation, a sudden and tragic trap is sprung.

An ADV about the tentacle assault of holy maidens.

Part of the original fantasy series "the Legend of the Deep". 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE042798.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
圣城埃鲁库，圣女的伊甸园。
在人们期待已久的索菲亚王后加冕之日，一个突然而悲惨的陷阱出现了。

关于圣女触手袭击的ADV。

原创奇幻系列“深海传说”的一部分。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE042798.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
